title: Day Dots
description: Products from the Jamba Shelf-Life Chart and the day dot each one gets at every step of its life (e.g. thawed in the walk-in, then opened).

disabled.description: true to hide something this store doesn't use. JSON has no comments, so this keeps the chart entry without showing it.

source.description: Which chart the items came from, e.g. 'June 2026 Shelf-Life Chart'.

dotColors.description: Sticker colour for each weekday the item must be used by.

searchNicknames.description: Store shorthand that searches for the full name, e.g. {"oj": "orange juice", "pango": "passion mango"}. Keys are matched against the whole search (lowercase); results show the real name.

categories.description: Display order of the category groups (chart order).

detail.description: Optional sub-line, e.g. the flavours a concentrate covers.

aliases.description: Extra search words that should find this item, e.g. the juice flavours covered by 'Hand Mixed Juices (All)'. Shown under the name when a search matches one.

category.description: Must be one of the listed categories.

steps.description: The product's life in order, read left to right. Each step gets its own day dot, replacing the previous one.

label.description: What starts this clock, e.g. 'Thawed in walk-in', 'Opened'.

short.description: Name shown under the dot when a product has several stages. Defaults to the first word of label ('Thawed in walk-in' → 'Thawed').

dayDot.description: false when the chart gives a shelf life but doesn't say '(Day Dot)'.

note.description: Extra rule from the chart, e.g. 'Discard end of day if cut'.
